title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Golf’s 2026 Turkey Awards
items.text: The 2026 Turkey Awards expose unsavory PGA Tour issues like unpaid vendors and caddie health scares that the sport must address.

items.headline: Anthony Kim's Health Battle
items.text: Anthony Kim revealed his career pause was due to a severe physical breakdown leaving him saying, “I don’t have any bones left.”

items.headline: Woods’ Legal Setback & Return
items.text: Tiger Woods faced a trademark lawsuit dismissal but plans to return at December’s Hero World Challenge, with Davis Love III urging a careful comeback.
